ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account action against the driver.
ruling.reasoning: Driver cancelled the completed-booking pickup (cancelled_by = driver, 13:05:30, $6.61 fee on record), so the case enters through NS-0 and turns on whether the driver's no-show claim satisfies NS-1 (i)–(iii) [F4][F7][NS-0]. The driver did confirm arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 at 39 m from pickup, and the closest approach was 38 m, so (i) and (ii) pass [F1][F6][NS-1]. The continued-wait requirement (iii) fails: after the 13:02:35 tap the driver stayed inside the 200 m radius for only 175 seconds before cancelling at 13:05:30, under the 180-second (> 3 min) threshold; the stationary spell of 3 min 15 s began at 13:02:15, i.e. before the tap, and pre-tap waiting does not count under NS-1 (iii) [F3][F6][NS-1]. Chat #2 "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" is the driver's own assertion of elapsed time and does not extend the measured post-tap wait [F10][NS-1]. Because one of the NS-1 elements fails, the $6.61 must be fully refunded to the rider [F7][NS-2]. The NS-2 rider-side flag is not triggered: the trace shows the arrival confirmation was made at 39 m from pickup, i.e. no fake or off-location confirmation [F1][F6][NS-2]. The driver's profile (2 disputes, 1 upheld no-show, 772 trips) supports nothing on its own and RD-6 concerns upheld route deviation, not no-shows, so no account flag is raised [F17][RD-6]. Amount: the fee charged is $6.61 and is refunded in full — $6.61 [F7][NS-2].

what_would_change: Had NS-1 (iii) held ((iii) stayed at the pickup more than 3 min after the arrival confirmation, until cancelling (NS-1 default: more than 3 min)), the fee would stand and no refund would be due.
